identity_policy.office_directory_rule: A PD-MF-OFF identifier is a Por Derecho canonical directory identity for an office/route. It is not an official Ministerio Fiscal reference and does not replace any existing global institution record.
identity_policy.expediente_namespace: Existing Master_ID values such as GC-FIS-016, TF-FIS-008, LZ-FIS-045 and NAT-FIS-004 remain controlling; no renumbering is permitted.
identity_policy.event_rule: Every source-proved filing, receipt, response, decree, notice, acknowledgement, routing act or transport event receives one stable PD-SP-EVT identifier. The event identifier is separate from REGAGE/RedSARA, NIG, DI, DIP, EG, ST, CC/CA and court references.
identity_policy.caret_rule: The ^ marker identifies a locked canonical identity. It does not convert an event, receipt, allegation or procedural assertion into an adjudicated fact.
identity_policy.no_collapse_rule: Transport, formal registration, official act/decision, notification and proceeding identity remain separate records and are linked rather than collapsed.

proof_boundaries: A REGAGE/RedSARA receipt proves formal presentation to the destination shown on the receipt, not internal delivery, allocation, joinder, examination, admission, investigation or merits.
An official acknowledgement proves only the handling state stated in the acknowledgement.
An official decree or decision proves that the act was issued and its stated reasoning/outcome; it does not prove the complete expediente, correctness, intent, wrongdoing or criminality.
Institutional possession does not prove personal knowledge by an identified Fiscal.
No aggregate-only RedSARA record may be converted into a synthetic individual event without an individual source.

coverage_baseline.historical_rule: The historical lane is append-only. The 2011/2012 traceability request is a scope instruction, not proof that a Fiscalía filing existed in those years. The earliest presently registered direct prosecution file in the controlled master register is DI 273/2013.
